svg.text: The ADA slice — one node, two edges, four things that can stand at them
Phases 2-4 build the node at 10.99.0.12. Each neighbour is an address, so a real node and a stand-in are interchangeable behind it.
R3 JSONL on stdout — argv and exit codes only
one image layer — no volume, no video pin
the node captures its own ADA-to-IVI egress
one ethernet OUTPUT pin to the bridge (R6)
The node's image, command, capabilities and env are identical whichever pair stands at its two edges, so a difference between two runs is a finding about the neighbour rather
VehicleC is never in the clip, so VehicleC can reach the store only through the relayed path — that is a property of the footage, not of any filter in the code.
Not built here: the CPM encode and decode upstream of R2, and the god-view rendering downstream of R4.
second process of the same image
